info.name: SRD 5.1: Basics
info.description: Skills, saving throws, proficiencies, languages, alignments and senses.
info.author: dndbuilder contributors (SRD 5.1 content by Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0)

description.p: The System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast, released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. It contains the core rules, nine races, the twelve classes with one subclass each, the Acolyte background, equipment, spells and magic items.

element.name: Acrobatics
element.supports: Skill, Dexterity, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Fighter, Monk, Rogue, Bard

description.p: Staying on your feet in tricky situations: balancing, tumbling, flips and stunts. (Dexterity)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Acrobatics checks.

element.name: Animal Handling
element.supports: Skill, Wisdom, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Barbarian, Druid, Fighter, Ranger, Bard

description.p: Calming, controlling or reading the intentions of animals. (Wisdom)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Animal Handling checks.

description.p: Recalling lore about spells, magic items, planes and arcane symbols. (Intelligence)

element.name: Athletics
element.supports: Skill, Strength, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Barbarian, Fighter, Monk, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, Bard

description.p: Climbing, jumping, swimming and other feats of physical strength. (Strength)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Athletics checks.

description.p: Spotting, hearing or otherwise noticing the presence of something. (Wisdom)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Perception checks.
Delighting an audience with music, dance, acting or storytelling. (Charisma)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Performance checks.

element.name: Religion
element.supports: Skill, Intelligence, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Cleric, Druid, Monk, Paladin, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard, Bard

description.p: Recalling lore about deities, rites, prayers and religious hierarchies. (Intelligence)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Religion checks.
Acts of legerdemain or manual trickery, such as planting or concealing objects. (Dexterity)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Sleight of Hand checks.

element.name: Stealth
element.supports: Skill, Dexterity, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Monk, Ranger, Rogue, Bard

description.p: Concealing yourself from enemies and moving without being noticed. (Dexterity)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Stealth checks.

element.name: Survival
element.supports: Skill, Wisdom, ID_PROFICIENCY_SKILL, Barbarian, Druid, Fighter, Ranger, Bard

description.p: Following tracks, hunting, guiding a group and predicting the weather. (Wisdom)
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Survival checks.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using thieves’ tools.

The secret language of druids.
A secret mix of dialect, jargon and code that lets rogues hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.
You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).
You can perceive your surroundings without relying on sight, within a specific radius.
You can see in normal and magical darkness, see invisible creatures and objects, and see through illusions.
You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within a specific radius.
